clues.it: Giada era l'unica persona su una grata, a ovest di Vito e nel Criosonno.
clues.en: Giada was the only person on a floor grate, west of Vito and in the Cryo Bay.

clues.it: Ugo era nella 2ª riga, accanto a un oblò e a nord di Marta.
clues.en: Ugo was in the 2nd row, beside a porthole and north of Marta.

clues.it: Sergio era accanto a una poltrona, a ovest di Rosa e in Serra.
clues.en: Sergio was beside a flight seat, west of Rosa and in the Greenhouse.

clues.it: Irene era nella 7ª colonna e nella 4ª riga, ma non era accanto a un fascio di cavi.
clues.en: Irene was in the 7th column and in the 4th row, but was not beside a cable bundle.

clues.it: Vito era nella 15ª colonna, nella 5ª riga e a ovest di Fabio.
clues.en: Vito was in the 15th column, in the 5th row and west of Fabio.

clues.it: Tea era nella 10ª colonna e nella 6ª riga, ma non era accanto a una grata.
clues.en: Tea was in the 10th column and in the 6th row, but was not beside a floor grate.

clues.it: Anna era nella 3ª colonna, accanto a una poltrona e in una stanza diversa da Fabio.
clues.en: Anna was in the 3rd column, beside a flight seat and in a different room from Fabio.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da sola con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Nino era accanto a una criocapsula, a nord di Rosa e in Mensa.
clues.en: Nino was beside a cryopod, north of Rosa and in the Mess Hall.

clues.it: Elena era in una stanza diversa da Sergio e in Mensa.
clues.en: Elena was in a different room from Sergio and in the Mess Hall.

clues.it: Paolo era nella 11ª colonna e accanto a un oblò.
clues.en: Paolo was in the 11th column and beside a porthole.

clues.it: Marta era nella 6ª colonna e accanto a un serbatoio, ma non era accanto a una criocapsula.
clues.en: Marta was in the 6th column and beside a fuel tank, but was not beside a cryopod.

clues.it: Dario era a ovest di Fabio e da solo nella Sala Macchine.
clues.en: Dario was west of Fabio and alone in the Engine Room.

clues.it: Olga era nella 5ª colonna, nella 14ª riga e nella stessa stanza di Marta.
clues.en: Olga was in the 5th column, in the 14th row and in the same room as Marta.

clues.it: Rosa era nella 14ª colonna e in una stanza diversa da Paolo.
clues.en: Rosa was in the 14th column and in a different room from Paolo.

clues.it: Fabio era nella 16ª colonna e nella 16ª riga, ma non era accanto a un'antenna.
clues.en: Fabio was in the 16th column and in the 16th row, but was not beside an antenna.

general_clues.en: 8 in the west half of the grid.
8 in the north half of the grid.

steps.en: Ugo's own clue leaves a single free square: row 2nd, column 8th.

steps.it: Irene può stare solo nella 4ª riga: escludendola, a Anna resta una sola casella: riga 7ª, colonna 3ª.
steps.en: Irene can only be in the 4th row: ruling it out leaves Anna a single square: row 7th, column 3rd.

steps.en: The general clue “3 beside a cryopod” cannot add up without Dario: they must be at row 13th, column 1st.
